1. Content

- Without content you have nothing to optimize.

- The internet is expanding so fast in terms of content, live video and short videos work the best.

- Realize that no content is unique, personality is.

2. Targeting and Nicheing Down

- If you don't niche down, you compete with everyone. Rankings are too hard to target when you do too much of everything, (look at Jerry Banfield).

3. Controlling Your Traffic and Relationship Building

- If you don't control your traffic, your traffic is cold, therefore your long term results are based on other peoples assets. Not a good idea.

4. User Engagement and User Generated Content

- All search engines perfer to rank content that has high user metrics such as high rention rates, engagement, and user generated content.

5. Social Signals

- Sending traffic and users from social platforms is almost the ultimate way to create rankings.

PPL billing recommendations for working directly with a local business:

Set your call tracking software to not display the caller ID of the customer to your client.

A lead is billable when:

- Phone rings more than 4 times without an answer 
- Client asks for the customers information
- Client sets an appointment
- Refers another company
- Asks for the customer to call back on a different number
- Customer goes to voicemail

(you should have your call tracking software send them the customer's information via text and/or email if the lead is billable)

Have their credit card ready, bill them weekly, and allow them access to listen to the calls.

The more time you spend getting really good at one thing you actually get good at that one thing.
Understand that there is A TON of opportunity, but you can’t be really good at everything. By becoming sort of good at everything, people will care a lot less about what you’re trying to do.
True money comes from talent, not from mediocrity.
Work doesn’t have to be extremely complicated, but it does have to be something you know enough about.
People buy from people who are CONSISTENTLY good at what they are selling or giving away.
You scale your business a lot faster and people end up respecting you more.

R8T4KVNcRng.title: SEO AUDIT FOR ADDICTION TREATMENT SITE
R8T4KVNcRng.author: CA$H BOT
R8T4KVNcRng.description:
Make sure you grab the free checklist here: https://bit.ly/3fHNTVb
Before we get started, make sure you check out my new FREE SEO template which can be found here: https://chasereiner.com

Today we do an SEO audit for a local addiction treatment site. Want an audit like this one? Just head over to https://chasereiner.com/ and let me know!

Don't forget to join the Facebook group while you're there!

Here's what we found:

SEO ROADMAP FOR RECOVERYFUSION.COM

1. Create related landing pages based off keywords found through local searches
2. Setup conversion tracking for online and offline conversions
3. Keyword research (based off competitors through AHREF’s)
4. Want to no index pages like: https://www.recoveryfusion.com/home/ / https://www.recoveryfusion.com/search 
5. Want to get rid of blog indexing based off dates and change to categories.
6. Fill out all meta descriptions on the site.
7. Have H1’s try to replicate title tag
8. Fix OG Data on main pages.
9. Get rid of organization markup, keep local.
10. See if we can get rid of duplicate website markup.
11. Do internal siloing and external links on pages.
12. See if we can make footer more condensed. 
13. If possible, let’s put a CTA on the above fold.
14. Home page would be better if we could add some services tabs that we could link to our different services or other important pages.
15. Might be a good idea to condense the following pages: what we do, about us, and why recovery fusion.
16. We want to have the services tab showing with a drop down of the different services we offer.
17. Would be a good idea to do keyword research on related areas and see if we can get any searches from them.
18. Is there anyway we can fix the huge pictures (make them smaller) in square space blog?
19. Put a blog preview description with internal links going to valuable posts.
20. Add posts to GMB and setup the call / text option.
21. Might be a good idea to spend a $100 per month on local extensions for the map listing. 
22. Start a Facebook support group for people who interested in the type of content you put out.
23. Find a keyword that has tip based user intent (do outreach for tips on the subject) but at same time ask for interviews on Google hangouts (you can send a calendar invite through YCB.ME)
24. Setup content upgrades (through Thrive and Text to signup).
25. Create CTA’s in content and funnel people to these assets.
26. Ask for reviews through Pleper on Social.
27. When outreaching for tips, the best way to streamline this is to use Google forms to ask questions.
28. Can also repurpose content from tips into slides to present on Youtube as well. 
29. Blog layout really needs to change it’s very large and should condensed similar to how Backlinko posts look.

TOP 10 ROADMAP 

1. Setup online and offline conversion tracking
2. Keyword research (what do you want to show up for (BASED OFF USER INTENT))
3. Build out content for landing pages based off the keywords and user intent.
4. Basic on page optimizations for current pages on the site + the new ones added from via keyword research. NOTE: Basic on page optimizations should be title tags, heading tags, alt tags, meta descriptions, internal and external linking, LSI keyword mapping.
5. Create content outline for first skyscraper article based off keyword research for national intent.
6. Setup content upgrades (figure out how to setup opt in’s for square space).
7. Start outreach through Pitchbox or Ninjaoutreach for tips and interviews for Google hangouts.
8. Start outreaching for reviews with Pleper to generate more authority locally but also nationally. 
9. Setup Instapage or Clickfunnels page to funnel people into the second step of the value ladder which can be, “get a free consultation, book now, etc.”
10. Fix OG data for sharing and start publishing content in different Facebook groups to be able to start grabbing traffic through the content upgrades and siphoning to your groups or email newsletters.

plRCrXsLk40.title: SEO Tip Of The Day (10): Content Streamlining
plRCrXsLk40.author: CA$H BOT
plRCrXsLk40.description:
Make sure you grab the free checklist here: https://bit.ly/3fHNTVb
Before we get started, make sure you check out my new FREE SEO template which can be found here: https://chasereiner.com

What is up there, SEO pros? How are you guys doing today?

All right. So today, we’re covering streamlining your content. I do this for clients and I also do this for my own stuff and today what we’re using is something called Pitchbox. You can use whatever you want, as long as you’re outreaching to people. So with Pitchbox, you can go and find keywords associated with certain articles that you’re going for.

So if we wanted to go for instance for something like “beginner fishing tips for 2017,” we could go out and email anybody with a website associated with fishing tips or fishing and ask them for their top tip around beginner fishing tips.

Now I actually did this and I did a case study and we were able to get somebody to rank number one for beginner fishing tips right here and get them featured in the knowledge graph. So they’re getting a lot of traffic from this and this was all from automated outreach which is what we’re doing for other clients right now as well.

So you can see this is the beginning of the article and then these are just the different tips with links to the people. Now the reason why people are so likely to contribute to this is because generally if you can say that you’re going to link back to them, they will be likely to leave a tip because people want links.

So you can see right here this is one that I did for myself. So if I click into here and then I go to inbox, these are all the different people who have messaged me back and basically all I said was hey – well, actually, I will show you my templates. So if we go into Campaigns and then we go to here and templates and here – and I think I actually have a tutorial on how I set this stuff up. But you will see this actually pulls their information from their sites, which is pretty cool.

So you will see it says – if opportunity is found on – there’s a certain URL. Use that URL. So basically it puts their site in their – and then else [0:02:02] [Phonetic], if they have a blog name, put their blog name and then if they have a first name. Like if it’s able to find this information. Pitchbox can go out and find this information which is really cool. Then I have other if-then statements. But I will show you what it looks like with all the names in there. So the blog name will just say “SEO Blog”. We will say the first name is SEO Guy and the opportunity URL found on www.SEO.com.

So that’s what it looks like. So subject, SEO.com, SEO Blog, SEO Guy. The reason why you want this stuff to change is you don’t want to send the same email out from your server over and over again. Otherwise, you will start to get those emails blocked.

So hi SEO Guy. My name is Chase Reiner. Here’s my Facebook profile, if you like to find out more about me. I know you’re incredibly busy. So I will be quick. I’m currently putting together a list of my – tips on my site around underutilized white hat SEO techniques for 2017 and then that’s a link to the actual article.

I already have over 10,000 words and over 60 tips with contributors such as Bill Slawski and Alan Bleiweiss. The post is already ranking, yada, yada. So that’s pretty much it. You just want to make sure you include the CAN-SPAM Act, so you can’t get in trouble. Then that’s how you do that and then I just send out the emails to people based on certain keywords. So this will go and find. So if I go here, these are all the keywords it’s pulling or websites it’s pulling from the searches with certain keywords.

So if I go under here and I look at – let’s say I will just do like SEO tactics or something. It will go and give me ideas and what I can do is I can just start adding these to the list and this will find all the sites talking about this stuff, which is really cool, because now I have basically scraped a list of URLs, which it will go and find these people’s names or emails, social media profiles. It will even show like certain things like their Klout score and what not if you want to find that.

What you do is once you get this list put together, it’s basically free content. You just put on your site and then you just tell these people, hey look, this is what we did. If you want to share it, here’s a share button and then if you want to link to it, feel free to link to it.

That’s how you can start getting links as well, which is really cool. So this method works really well. We’re doing it for multiple clients. I’m also doing it for like the insurance website. We’re going to be doing it for Well Scent which is the holistic central oil apothecary. I can’t pronounce that last word, that we’re working with. We’re going to do a top list for them as well.

24. Need to make meta descriptions more unique
25. Title lengths are really low, need fix 
26. Build out citations and Google my business location

1. Setup Analytics and Search Console with Conversion tracking and also setup rank tracking
2. Basic on page for top level pages and work your way down (fixing duplicate title tags, heading tags, meta descriptions, etc.)

10. Get content upgrades and email sign up started as well as Facebook funnel

eYu2TO3vAEE.title: 2018 SEO Checklist ☑️️ (11 Actionable Tips)
eYu2TO3vAEE.author: CA$H BOT
eYu2TO3vAEE.description:
Make sure you grab the free checklist here: https://bit.ly/3fHNTVb
Before we get started, make sure you check out my new FREE SEO template which can be found here: https://chasereiner.com

SEO Checklist 2018 (11 Actionable Tips)

1. Basic understanding of SEO and HTML: Title tags, heading tags, alt tags, bold / italics, etc. 

2. Understand basic keyword research (I use two keyword tools: keywordtool.io and answerthepublic.com) Try not to over complicate your keyword research but do spend time looking at user intent and optimizing for user experience for said keywords.

(Keyword Research tutorial: https://youtu.be/DrYwXqfWDi4?t=34)

3. On page SEO Basics: Use a free or paid SEO checker like SEOcentro, SEOsitecheckup, or SEOProfiler. Most of this stuff you should be able to eye ball if you understand the basics. However, if you're going to be really competitive with your SEO you will want to use a good on page grader. IMO, SEO centro is the best you can get at the moment. Also, don't under estimate the power of on page link building.

On Page SEO Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czHzrGGapAg&t=1079s

4. Off page SEO basics: Start doing email outreach with contextual targeting. Do guest posting, broken link building, expert round ups. I use pitchbox and email hunter.

Off Page SEO tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=deV20LkcHIY&t=1585s

5. Basic understanding of Google Analytics.

Google Analytics tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S1TaZZnozyk&t=5s

6. Repurpose content and try to dive into visual content as much as possible.

Repurposing content tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PB67BdlOo_s&list=PLdb0X6BY62MTlV0kTauWGiJm3eqLMRmnz

7. STAY away from bad / useless information: Anything about PBN's or buying links. (Buying citations are OK)

8. Streamline if you can. Don't spend time doing tasks that you could have some one else help you with. You should always be learning in this industry as information moves at the speed of lightning.

Pitchbox tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kp-FFMcZGwg&t=137s

9. Understand a little bit about similar niches like SMM, Email Marketing, SEM, A/B Testing, etc. This will help you get a better overall understanding of your audience and overall online marketing campaigns. 

10. Don't get outdated. Type in "SEO News" on Google every couple days or so and check out what's coming out. Get familiar with the different algorithms like Rank Brain.

11. MOST IMPORTANTLY: don't question yourself. SEO can be EXTREEMLY difficult to stay motivated with as it's extreemly competitive and there are a lot of people who will seem to know more than you. This might be true but you can get very skilled in one catagory of SEO (like local seo for example) and present your own unique value and skills after in a short amount of time. Remember, it doesn't matter if you're the best. It only matters if you're able to help peoples businesses out in ways that those business owners wouldn't be able to do themselves WITH WHITE HAT SEO.

Good luck guys :)

Here are the SEO notes we made from today: 

Content analytics and Heatmaps

Reduce image size on blog posts like http://inkbotdesign.com/5-typography-artists-worth-following/ and pull to right to improve UX

Think about content upgrades

figure out goals in analytics

On page signal optimizations

Consider A/B testing with optimizely

Double check OG data perhaps implement plugin like SSO Pro or Yoast pro

Start doing author markup

Put last updated instead of date published

Bold and italics utilization

Implement share buttons

Consider repurposing content on top traffic pages

Remove irrelavent anchor text and replace with the name of the pages instead

Start tracking keywords and rankings with rank tracker

Consider adding brand name in title

Consider local business location or service area

Remove unnecesary caps on the home page meta description

For home page more heavily target area and graphic design with content

Start using SSL

For home page use schema local markup with address 

For services page do orginization markup

Start setting up conversion funnels

DO A / B on http://inkbotdesign.com/services/

Maybe implement hot jar or crazy egg

Consider remarketing through adwords
